units.source_text: “这么多尼姑聚到一块，在冰天雪地里呆几个月，不知都在干些什么呢？

en.t: With so many nuns gathered together, spending months in the snow and ice, I wonder what on earth they do there?

units.source_text: 这一带旧时织绉纱，她们在尼姑庵里要是也织织就好啦。”

en.t: They used to weave crepe around here; it would be nice if those women wove some in the convent too.
